title: Geometry-calibrated equilibrium sensing for inverse design of nonlocal topological photonic lattices
summary: Topological photonic lattices are commonly designed using short-range Hamiltonians, yet realistic nanophotonic structures are governed by geometry- and wavelength-dependent long-range electromagnetic interactions. Here we introduce a geometry-calibrated quantum equilibrium-propagation framework for inference and inverse design in finite nonlocal plasmonic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattices. A two-qubit equilibrium sensor is trained in effective-coupling space to distinguish boundary-localized from trivial finite-lattice responses.
